newsitem.title: USA: Singer sees meeting 1996 EPS forecast.
newsitem.headline: Singer sees meeting 1996 EPS forecast.

text.p: The Singer Co N.V. said on Thursday it expected to meet its earnings forecast for 1996.
The company has said it expects 1996 earnings per share to be slightly ahead of the $1.64 reported last year.

The company reported third-quarter earnings of $20.1 million, or $0.39 a share, with a charge of $1.5 million. In the same period last year Singer had earnings of $11.8 million, or $0.23 a share, with a $12.8 million special charge.

"While most of our operations around the world are growing on expectations, we remain concerned about the unfavorable market conditions in Europe and their impact on approaching Christmas sales," James Ting, the chairman and chief executive, said in a statement.
"In spite of these uncertainties, Singer expects to meet earnings expectations for 1996."
Singer said results benefited from lower interest rates in Mexico. "Our performance in Mexico is encouraging and we remain cautiously optimistic about continued improvement there," said Ting.
